description: Company / domain enrichment from its website. Enrich a company domain: name, title, description, social profiles (LinkedIn, X, GitHub, etc.), contact emails and phones found on the homepage, language, tech hints (frameworks, analytics), mail provider from MX records, and key pages (about, pricing, careers, contact). Deterministic, no LLM, public data only. Example output: {"domain":"stripe.com","name":"Stripe","description":"Financial infrastructure...","socials":{"linkedin":"https://www.linkedin.com/company/stripe"},"emails":[],"mailProvider":"google","tech":["next.js"],"pages":{"pricing":"https://stripe.com/pricing"}}. Price: $0.008 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
name: company_enrich
